text:
sylvie: quick check — streaming question: if a model emits a tool/function call mid-stream, how should clients interpret the sequence of delta events? i.e., do we send a separate `tool_call` event type or encode start/chunk/end signals inside the normal delta payload?

matt: historically we had the single-delta-with-flag approach (delta.role + delta.content + delta.tool_call?). but that got messy for partial tool args streaming.

jordan: my vote: explicit small event types makes client code simpler. e.g. `delta`, `tool_call_start`, `tool_call_arg`, `tool_call_end`. then streaming parser can switch state machine based on event type.

lee: worry: adding new event types is breaking for older SDKs that only expect `delta` messages. we should define a compatibility layer.

matt: agreed. proposal: new event type `tool_call_*` is opt-in via request header `x-rw-toolcall-stream=v1`. default remains old behaviour (single delta with embedded `tool_call` object). that keeps backwards compat.

sylvie: example request snippet?

matt: sure — client sets header and server can emit typed frames:
```
: delta { "role": "assistant", "content": "Thinking..." }
: tool_call_start { "name": "lookup_user" }
: tool_call_arg { "key": "user_id", "value_chunk": "abc" }
: tool_call_arg { "key": "user_id", "value_chunk": "123" }
: tool_call_end { "status": "complete" }
: delta { "role": "assistant", "content": "Done." }
```

jordan: also important: how do we signal that tool args are incomplete (partial JSON) vs complete? suggest `value_chunk` + `final: true` on the final arg event, or an explicit `tool_call_end` with `args_complete: true`.

lee: and offline parsers: they'd need to assemble `value_chunk`s. fine as long as we document framing. but we must guard token accounting / billing semantics — partial chunks shouldn't be billed twice. question for infra.

sylvie: infra/billing ping: @ci-bot do we have a clear token accounting model for streaming partial tool args vs full arg blobs?

ci-bot: billing: triggering owners — tagging infra-billing. Canary infra change (canary-2026-03-17) does not change token meter. please wait for confirmation. :white_check_mark:

matt: one more edge: what if model starts emitting a tool_call then switches back to normal text without closing? clients need a timeout/backstop. propose server always emits an explicit `tool_call_end` before switching context OR a `context_switch` event if forced.

jordan: +1 for explicit end. fallback policy: if `x-rw-toolcall-stream` not present, server falls back to embedding toolcall in `delta` object as before — keep shape backward compatible.

sylvie: sounds good. I'll draft a tiny spec doc and a reference parser in the SDK. can someone review a quick PR when ready? ping @matt @jordan.

matt: can do, ping me in PR.

lee: please add a short compatibility note for mobile SDKs (they update slower). also add an opt-out test in our API contract suite.

sylvie: will do — pushing a draft soon. thanks all. :pray:
